facts.text: I am considering starting a blog about fashion and sustainability.
I have been reading a lot of fashion magazines lately.
I am inspired by the photography and design in fashion magazines.
I am considering using a minimalist design for my blog.
I want a lot of whitespace and simple typography for my blog.
I was thinking of using a clean white background for my blog.
I was thinking of using a simple sans-serif font for my blog.
I want to incorporate nature-inspired elements like a small leaf or flower icon.
I think I will start by experimenting with simple icon designs using Adobe Illustrator.
I have never designed an icon before.
I want to keep the icon designs simple and minimalist, like a small leaf or a stylized flower.
I like the idea of using a muted green accent color for the nature-inspired theme.
I am considering using a green color similar to the color of leaves or flowers versus a more muted, earthy tone.
I think I will start by using the icon and green accent color in my logo and headers.
I want to create a simple yet eye-catching logo that incorporates the leaf or flower icon and the green accent color.
I want to use the logo in the header of my blog.
I might use the logo as a favicon.
For the headers, I want to use the green accent color as a background or text color.
I might use the icon as a bullet point or separator in my headers.
I am not sure yet about using the icon and green accent color as a background texture.
I want to strike a balance so the design does not become too busy or overwhelming.
I am thinking about how to balance the fashion and sustainability aspects of my blog.
